name: @bossnyumba/translation
description: translate() facade — DB-cached, Claude-backed. Mirrors @borjie/translation. Wraps Anthropic SDK with a translation_cache table so repeated string translations short-circuit before hitting Claude. Used by every non-chat surface that produces user-facing text: emails, PDFs, push, SMS, audit log render, decision-journal render, webhooks, cron workers. Real-estate (BossNyumba) domain hint in the system prompt; Tanzanian Swahili variant rule preserved.
